Yes — Americans can visit Phu Quoc Island visa-free under the Phu Quoc exemption, which is open to all nationalities.

Key details:
- Stay allowed: up to 30 days
- You must arrive directly from outside Vietnam by air or sea — this exemption only covers Phu Quoc itself; traveling on to mainland Vietnam voids it and requires a separate visa
- Passport must be valid for at least 180 days from your entry date

If you want to visit the mainland too (or need more flexibility), you can instead get an e-Visa, which is available to all nationalities for up to 90 days, costs USD 25 (single-entry) or USD 50 (multiple-entry), takes about 2-3 business days to process, and lets you enter through any of 83 approved air/land/sea ports.

This data is current as of 2026-08-17 — double-check at evisa.gov.vn before you travel, since policy can change.
